entities.name: anxiety and depression after spinal cord injury

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: The NLRP3 inflammasome plays a crucial role in various diseases by controlling the release of proinflammatory molecules like interleukin 1β (IL-1β) and IL-18.

key_findings: Review: NLRP3 inflammasome dysregulation in prefrontal cortex and hippocampus contributes to mood disorders after SCI.
